suppress.notes: CVE-2026-33117 is in the Key Vault *Keys* library of the Azure SDK for Java (affected: < 4.10.6). This project uses com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys 4.10.6, i.e. the fixed release, and Dependency-Check does not flag it. The jars below only match because their CPE is the umbrella product "azure_sdk_for_java", which has no per-library version. OSV/GHSA list no advisory for any of them.

CVE-2023-36415 affects azure-identity for Java before 1.10.2 (MITRE record: "Azure Identity SDK for Java 1.0.0 < 1.10.2"). This project uses azure-identity 1.18.3. The match comes from a CPE version range that does not distinguish the per-language SDKs; OSV/GHSA list no advisory for 1.18.3.

dev.cel:protobuf is the Common Expression Language (cel-java) module that grpc-xds pulls in at runtime (optional); it is not protobuf-java. CVE-2022-3171 and CVE-2024-7254 are protobuf-java parsing issues; the CPE "protobuf-java 0.13.0" is matched only because of the cel module's own version number. protobuf-java itself is a separate artifact and is not flagged. OSV/GHSA list no advisory for dev.cel:protobuf.
